title: AgentConfigProfile
description: Canonical schema for user-confirmed, host-scoped and workspace-scoped execution profiles. Strictly separates host availability from user-confirmed tier mappings, and abstract effort policies from host-resolved discrete values.

profile_version.description: Schema version of the profile document.

host.description: Host binding defining identity and adapter for this profile.

id.description: Identifier of the agent host (e.g. codex, opencode, claude-code).

adapter.description: Identifier of the adapter implementing inspection and mutation for this host.

provider.description: Optional model provider identity if relevant to the host.

platform.description: Optional runtime platform or OS identifier.

scope.description: Isolation scope preventing profiles from leaking across workspaces or hosts.

workspace.description: Canonical filesystem path or workspace identifier.

model_mode.description: Operating mode: single fixed model harness (first-class) or selectable multi-model harness.

single_model.description: Configuration for single-model harnesses. Defines execution and review effort policies without artificial tier routing.

tiers.description: User-confirmed mapping from abstract difficulty tiers to real model IDs and effort policies. Automatic model intelligence guessing is strictly forbidden.

capabilities.description: User-confirmed or host-agreed execution topology capabilities.

effort_policy.description: Abstract effort policy (e.g. highest-supported) or explicit discrete string value.

policy.description: Abstract policy resolved by adapters at execution time against host-supported discrete values.

value.description: Explicit discrete effort value matching a host-supported option.

tier_mapping.description: User-confirmed tier assignment. Forbids automatic model ranking or intelligence heuristics.

model.description: User-confirmed model identifier assigned to this tier.

source.description: Provenance tag certifying that this mapping was confirmed by the user and never guessed.
